title: Motor Insurance Policy Schedule
key_sentences: This schedule forms part of your policy and must be read together with the policy booklet.
Please check the details below carefully and tell us straight away if anything is wrong.
Compulsory and voluntary excesses are added together.
Your policy includes a no claim discount for nine years.
Protecting the discount does not protect the premium, which may still rise after a claim.
If you choose not to use our approved repairer, an additional excess of £200 applies to any accidental damage claim.
To make a claim, call our claims line on 01632 960 755, available 24 hours a day.
Have your policy number and the registration of every vehicle involved ready when you call.

rows: Up to the market value of the vehicle
Repair free of excess; replacement excess £95
Small car while yours is repaired by an approved repairer
Up to 90 days per trip, same level of cover

list_items.text: 1. You must take all reasonable steps to protect the vehicle from loss or damage.
(a) Keep the vehicle locked and the keys out of sight when it is unattended.
(b) Keep the vehicle in a roadworthy condition and hold a valid MOT certificate where one is required.
2. You must tell us within 48 hours about any accident, loss or damage, whether or not you intend to claim.
3. You must tell us before the change takes effect if:
(a) you change your address or the place where the vehicle is kept overnight;
(b) you want to add a driver or change the use of the vehicle;
(c) a driver receives a motoring conviction or a medical condition affecting driving.
4. We may cancel the policy by giving you seven days' notice in writing to your last known address.
